datasets.name: Sichuan Province landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The landslide samples used in this article are from major landslide disaster events in and around Sichuan Province since 2008, produced in [38].

datasets.name: GF-2 satellite images
datasets.source: China National Space Administration (implied by GF-2)
datasets.verbatim: In addition, we also carried out landslide detection for Zhaotong of Yunnan Province on GF-2 original images to prove the effectiveness and applicability of the algorithm.

methods.name: DCI-PGCN (Dual-Channel Interaction Portable Graph Convolutional Network)
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation network combining a CNN encoder-decoder architecture with a novel DRP-GCN (Deep Residual Portable Graph Convolutional Network) module and a DBGIM (Dual-Branch Graph Interaction Module). It uses a global maximum node connection strategy to improve GCN portability and efficiency, and fuses information from different channels to refine landslide boundaries.
methods.source: Weiming Li, Yibin Fu, Shuaishuai Fan, Mingrui Xin, and Hongyang Bai

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the input imagery is mentioned without a link. The custom DCI-PGCN code is not provided or linked.
